summary: Hydrofarm Holdings Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the July 31, 2026 sale of all shares of its subsidiary Aurora Peat Products ULC to 2817049 Alberta Ltd. for $16 million in cash, with $5 million deferred via a secured promissory note assigned to the company's term-loan lenders. Net proceeds will reduce debt under the $125 million senior secured term loan. A supply agreement was also executed between Hydrofarm LLC and APP. The company acts as seller; no advisor or board recommendation is noted. Watch for debt-reduction impact and post-closing supply arrangements.
